intents.answer: Admission ke liye pehle online form bharo college website par, uske baad entrance score aur documents verify hote hain, fir merit list ke hisaab se seat allot hoti hai.
paraphrases: college me admission ka process kya hai
how do I get admission here

intents.answer: Is saal admission ki last date 30 June hai. Uske baad sirf management quota me seats available rahengi agar bachi hon.
paraphrases: admission ki last date kya hai
kab tak form bhar sakte hain

intents.answer: B.Tech ki fees ₹1,20,000 per year hai, isme tuition aur exam fees dono shamil hain. Hostel aur mess fees alag se lagti hai.
paraphrases: what is the fee for btech
b tech course fee kitni h

intents.answer: MBA ki fees ₹2,50,000 per year hai. Isme placement cell aur workshop charges bhi included hain.
paraphrases: what is the fee for mba

intents.answer: Hostel fees ₹60,000 per year hai, jisme room aur mess dono included hain. AC room ke liye extra ₹15,000 lagte hain.
paraphrases: how much is the hostel fee
what is hostel cost per year

intents.answer: Hostel ka entry gate raat 9 baje band hota hai aur subah 6 baje khulta hai. Late aane ke liye warden se pehle permission leni padti hai.
paraphrases: what time does the hostel gate close
hostel me kitne baje tak aa sakte hain
hostel gate kab band hota hai

intents.answer: Hostel me single aur double sharing dono room available hain. Allotment first-come-first-serve basis par hota hai admission ke baad.
paraphrases: single room mil sakta hai kya hostel me
hostel room allotment kaise hota hai
how do I get a hostel room

intents.answer: Semester exams December aur May me hote hain. Detailed datesheet exam se 3 hafte pehle notice board aur website par aata hai.
paraphrases: exam ka time table kab milega

intents.answer: Agar kisi subject me fail ho jao to reappear/back paper exam agle semester ke exam ke saath hi hota hai. Alag se form bharna padta hai.
paraphrases: exam me fail hone ke baad kya hota hai
back paper ka process kya hai
how to apply for supplementary exam
fail hone par dobara exam kaise doon

intents.answer: Scholarship un students ko milti hai jinke 12th me 85% se zyada marks hain ya jo economically weaker section se hain. Documents ke saath form bharna hota hai.
paraphrases: scholarship ke liye kya requirement hai

intents.answer: Scholarship ki amount ₹20,000 se ₹80,000 tak hoti hai, category aur marks ke hisaab se decide hoti hai.
paraphrases: scholarship me kitne paise milte hain
how much is the scholarship amount

intents.answer: Library subah 8 baje se raat 10 baje tak khuli rehti hai, Sunday ko bhi. Exam ke time me timing badh jati hai.
paraphrases: library open kab tak rehti hai

intents.answer: Ek student ek time me 3 books issue kara sakta hai, 15 din ke liye. Late return par per day ₹5 fine lagta hai.
paraphrases: library se kitni books mil sakti hain
how many books can I issue
book issue karne ka rule kya hai
kitne din ke liye book milti hai

intents.answer: Placement cell final year me companies invite karta hai. Process me aptitude test, group discussion aur interview hota hai.
paraphrases: placement ke rounds kya hote hain

intents.answer: Average package last year ₹4.5 LPA tha, aur highest package ₹18 LPA tha.
paraphrases: what is the average salary package
placement me kitni salary milti hai

intents.answer: ID card kho jaye to admin office me application do aur ₹200 fee ke saath duplicate card ban jata hai, 3-4 din lagte hain.
paraphrases: id card kho gaya kya karu
how to get duplicate id card

intents.answer: Fees online (net banking, UPI, card) ya college office me DD ke through bhari ja sakti hai. Cash accept nahi hota.
paraphrases: fee payment online ho sakti hai kya

intents.answer: Fees late deposit karne par per week ₹500 late fine lagta hai, aur 1 mahine se zyada late hone par seat cancel bhi ho sakti hai.
paraphrases: fees late bharne par kya hota hai
what is the fine for late fee payment
fees time pe nahi bhari to

intents.answer: Exam me baithne ke liye minimum 75% attendance zaroori hai. Medical leave ke case me relaxation admin se milti hai.
paraphrases: what is the minimum attendance required
kitni attendance honi chahiye exam ke liye
attendance kam ho to kya hoga

intents.answer: College bus city ke 6 major routes par chalti hai. Bus pass ke liye transport office me form bharna hota hai.
paraphrases: is there a college bus facility
college se ghar tak bus milti hai kya
